acceptance.given: A package declares multiple capabilities, with a compliant applicable control for one capability and a missing applicable control for another.

oracle.expected: The structured validator result rejects the package and identifies the missing applicable control while retaining evaluation of the compliant capability.
forbidden: The package is accepted because a compliant control for one capability masks the missing applicable control for another capability.
oracle.observable: Validator result status and diagnostics for the multi-capability fixture show rejection caused by the missing control and do not suppress the compliant capability's evaluation.

acceptance.then: The validator independently evaluates applicable controls for each declared capability and rejects the package when any declared capability lacks its applicable control.
acceptance.when: Run the real validator against a disposable multi-capability fixture during the capability test lane and inspect its structured result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Capability validation composes independent checks and rejects a multi-capability package when any applicable control is missing, even when another capability is compliant.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback restores prior validator and declaration behavior while preserving the versioned result shape and existing package protocols.

slice_hint.state_transition: Capability declarations transition from potentially masked per-capability evaluation to independent evaluation where any missing applicable control produces rejection.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The capability selector passes after asserting structured rejection for the missing control and confirming the compliant capability was not used to mask it.
